description: This Dart source file defines the 'ReportsScreen' widget and related classes for a Flutter application screen that displays daily and weekly attendance reports. It includes UI components such as tabs, date range pickers, and lists, and interacts with an API client to fetch report data.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: Main screen widget with tabs for Daily and Weekly reports.

classes.name: _DailyReportView
classes.description: Widget for displaying daily report data with date range picker.

classes.name: _WeeklyReportView
classes.description: Widget for displaying weekly report data with date range picker.

classes.name: _ReportList
classes.description: List widget used by both Daily and Weekly report views to display summarized report data.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state for ReportsScreen and report views.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including API client instances and controllers.

methods.name: _pickRange
methods.description: Allows user to select a date range for the report.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches report data from backend API based on selected date range.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for report screens, including tabs, buttons, and report list.
